name: Web server (host nginx): probe of a sensitive path
description: A request (the access logs in /var/log/nginx, combined format) for a file or page attackers look for: .env, .git, backups, wp-admin, phpMyAdmin, actuator and similar. The source is the last address of X-Forwarded-For (what the outer proxy saw, the rest is client-controlled), else the client address.
